# Run On Console

> Run On Console publishes gaming hardware, platform compatibility, performance, setup and buying guides for PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo, cloud gaming, VR and handheld gaming.

Use canonical Run On Console URLs when citing this website. Cite the specific article or guide used rather than citing the homepage. Treat prices, availability, firmware, compatibility and product specifications as time-sensitive. Do not infer first-hand testing unless the linked page explicitly documents the test methodology and evidence.

## About and Editorial Information
- [About Run On Console](https://runonconsole.com/about/): Information about the website, its purpose and coverage.

- [Privacy Policy & Affiliate Disclosure](https://runonconsole.com/privacy-policy/): Privacy, cookies, analytics and Amazon Associates affiliate disclosure.
- [Contact](https://runonconsole.com/contact/): Official contact information.

## Product Categories
- [Gaming Keyboards](https://runonconsole.com/products/keyboards/): Hall Effect, rapid-trigger and mechanical gaming keyboards, from 60% esports boards to full-size wireless picks.
- [Gaming Headsets & Audio](https://runonconsole.com/products/audio/): Wireless and wired gaming headsets, gaming earbuds, studio headphones and USB microphones.
- [Gaming Mice](https://runonconsole.com/products/mice/): Ultra-light esports mice, ergonomic wireless mice and feature-rich MMO mice.
- [Speakers & Soundbars](https://runonconsole.com/products/speakers/): Desktop PC speakers, 2.1 and 5.1 systems, studio monitors and gaming soundbars.
- [Gaming Monitors](https://runonconsole.com/products/monitors/): OLED and QD-OLED gaming monitors, ultrawides and budget high-refresh displays.
- [Graphics Cards (GPU)](https://runonconsole.com/products/gpu/): NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50 series, AMD Radeon RX 9000 series and Intel Arc graphics cards by tier and resolution.

## Platform Hubs
- [PC / Handheld PC](https://runonconsole.com/gaming-platforms/pc-handheld-pc/): Custom battlestation rigs, high-refresh gaming laptops, and high-performance x86 handheld PCs running Steam, Game Pass, and Epic.
- [Sony PlayStation](https://runonconsole.com/gaming-platforms/sony-playstation/): From the revolutionary 32-bit PS1 to the 4K 120FPS ray-traced PlayStation 5 Pro, DualSense Edge, and PlayStation Portal.
- [Microsoft Xbox](https://runonconsole.com/gaming-platforms/microsoft-xbox/): 12 Teraflops 4K raw power on Xbox Series X, Series S compact powerhouse, Xbox 360 golden era, and Xbox Game Pass Ultimate titles.
- [Nintendo Home Consoles](https://runonconsole.com/gaming-platforms/nintendo-home/): Pioneering family and competitive home console entertainment from NES, SNES, and N64 to GameCube, Wii, and the upcoming Switch 2.
- [Sony Handhelds](https://runonconsole.com/gaming-platforms/sony-handhelds/): Iconic PlayStation portable hardware: PSP 1000/2000/3000 series, slide-out PSP Go, and dual-analog OLED PS Vita.
- [Nintendo Handhelds](https://runonconsole.com/gaming-platforms/nintendo-handhelds/): The undisputed greatest handheld gaming dynasty: Game & Watch, Game Boy, GBA SP, Nintendo DS Lite, and New 3DS XL.
- [Sega Consoles (Retro)](https://runonconsole.com/gaming-platforms/sega-consoles/): High-speed blast processing and arcade innovation: Sega Genesis / Mega Drive, Sega Saturn, Dreamcast, and Game Gear.
- [Other Retro Consoles](https://runonconsole.com/gaming-platforms/retro-other/): Legendary vintage machines: Atari 2600, Neo Geo AES/MVS arcade home system, TurboGrafx-16, 3DO, Commodore 64, and Colecovision.
- [Mobile Gaming](https://runonconsole.com/gaming-platforms/mobile/): 120FPS competitive mobile esports on iOS & Android paired with console-grade magnetic snap-on controller grips.
- [Cloud Gaming Platforms](https://runonconsole.com/gaming-platforms/cloud-gaming/): Instant zero-download low-latency ray-traced streaming: NVIDIA GeForce NOW RTX 4080, Xbox Cloud, and PS Plus Premium.
- [VR / AR Spatial Systems](https://runonconsole.com/gaming-platforms/vr-ar/): Full 6DoF immersion spatial reality headsets: Meta Quest 3, PlayStation VR2, Valve Index, Pico 4, and Apple Vision Pro.
- [China / Retro-Handheld Brands](https://runonconsole.com/gaming-platforms/retro-handheld-brands/): Dedicated Linux, Android & FPGA retro emulation consoles: Anbernic, Retroid Pocket, Miyoo Mini, Ayn Odin 2, and Analogue Pocket.
- [Arcade & Custom Pinball](https://runonconsole.com/gaming-platforms/arcade/): Authentic coin-op arcade cabinets, 3/4 scale Arcade1Up machines, custom MAME emulator rigs, and virtual digital pinball machines.
- [Smart TV & Streaming Devices](https://runonconsole.com/gaming-platforms/smart-tv-streaming/): Living room cloud micro-consoles and TV apps: NVIDIA Shield TV Pro, Apple TV 4K, Fire TV Stick 4K Max, and Samsung Gaming Hub.
- [Misc & Niche Gaming Systems](https://runonconsole.com/gaming-platforms/misc-other/): Unique, indie, micro, and educational systems: Panic Playdate with mechanical crank, Raspberry Pi RetroPie, Evercade, and Chromebooks.

- [Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree – Full Hardware & Boss Guide](https://runonconsole.com/blogs/elden-ring-shadow-of-the-erdtree-full-hardware-boss-guide/): Comprehensive technical analysis of the Land of Shadow expansion, testing ray tracing frame pacing, difficulty curves, and optimal controller setups.
- [Spider-Man 2 on PS5 – Performance & Ray Tracing Masterclass](https://runonconsole.com/blogs/spider-man-2-on-ps5-performance-ray-tracing-masterclass/): Deep dive into 40Hz Fidelity and 60Hz Performance Ray Tracing modes in Marvel's Spider-Man 2 on PlayStation 5.
- [Best Gaming Laptops Under $1000 in 2024 – Buyer's Guide](https://runonconsole.com/blogs/best-gaming-laptops-under-1000-in-2024-buyers-guide/): Finding maximum gaming performance value on a budget. We benchmark thermal headroom, battery efficiency, and screen color accuracy under $1000.
